meta.name: google-maps-scraper
meta.description: Find businesses, leads, emails, reviews, ratings, and contact details from Google Maps. Use for requests such as "find dentists in Berlin", "scrape Google Maps", "get local business leads", or "collect Google Maps reviews". Runs the open-source scraper locally with Docker and guides nontechnical users through setup, monitoring, and results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入城市和行业,批量收集本地商家的电话、邮箱与评价
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果靠本地商家名单做销售拓客,却不想手动一条条整理
copy.tagline_en: Collect local business phone numbers, emails, and reviews in bulk by city and industry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build local prospect lists for sales and dread compiling them by hand

howto.what: 在本地用 Docker 运行开源 Google Maps 抓取器,从地图抓取商家列表及评分、评论、电话、网站、地址,可选提取邮箱;完成后给出结果预览表,并支持筛选、分析与导出。
howto.when: 当你要求找某类商家(如“找柏林牙医”)、抓取 Google Maps 线索或收集评论时触发;需先安装并运行 Docker。

howto.what_en: Runs an open-source Google Maps scraper in Docker locally: turns your request into search queries, collects listings with ratings, reviews, phone, website, address (optional emails), then shows a filterable results table.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find businesses of a type in a city (e.g. "find dentists in Berlin"), scrape Google Maps for leads, or collect Google Maps reviews. Docker must be installed and running.
